security_questions: What is the patient's certificate or identification number?
What is the date of service?
What is the patient's date of birth?
authentication.notes: RBC Insurance administers dental through Green Shield Canada (GSC) infrastructure — providerConnect.ca is the portal. Carrier ID on CDAnet is 000124. Group/plan number field is not used by RBCI — populate with 9999 if required. Member ID may include a hyphen with dependent code (e.g. 1234567-02) — enter all digits without the hyphen (123456702) unless your software has a separate dependent field.

steps.expected_prompt: Thank you for calling RBC Insurance. For English, press 1. Pour le français, faites le 2.
For group benefits and dental claims, press 1. For travel insurance, press 2. For life and disability, press 3.
For providers calling about a claim or patient eligibility, press 1. For plan members, press 2.
Please enter your provider identification number.
For claim status, press 1. For eligibility verification, press 2. For all other inquiries, press 3. To speak with a representative, press 0.
Please enter the patient's identification number.
steps.action: Enter [PATIENT_MEMBER_ID] digit by digit — omit any hyphens
steps.notes: Do not include hyphens. Enter all digits as one continuous number.

steps.expected_prompt: Please hold while we connect you to the next available representative.

common_denial_reasons.resolution: Verify procedure is on the patient's benefit schedule. Some plans exclude cosmetic, implants, or orthodontics
Most plans cap at $1,000-$2,000/year. Patient responsible for overage. Bill patient directly.
Standard limits: 2 cleanings/year, bitewing X-rays 1/year. Verify plan frequency schedule.
Major work typically over $500 requires pre-authorization. Submit via providerConnect.ca or fax.

common_denial_reasons.description: Coordination of benefits — other carrier is primary
common_denial_reasons.resolution: Submit to primary plan first, then submit EOB with COB claim to RBC Insurance.

common_denial_reasons.description: Patient not eligible on date of service
common_denial_reasons.resolution: Verify employment and coverage dates. Patient may have left employer or changed plans.

common_denial_reasons.description: Claim submitted under wrong carrier ID
common_denial_reasons.resolution: Ensure claim is submitted under carrier ID 000124, not old Green Shield ID. Resubmit with correct carrier.

required_attachments: X-rays for crowns, bridges, root canals
EOB from primary carrier for COB claims

key_phrases: I'm calling on behalf of [Practice Name] regarding an RBC Insurance claim
The carrier ID is 000124 and the patient's certificate number is [ID]
Can you confirm the claim was received and the current adjudication status?
What is the specific denial reason code?
Was an EOB issued to the patient or provider?
Is this claim eligible for appeal and what is the deadline?
avoid_phrases: Green Shield Canada — RBC Insurance uses its own carrier ID 000124 since 2016
Group number — RBCI does not use group numbers, say 9999 if asked
This should have been paid by now — non-productive, ask for status instead
escalation_triggers: Claim cannot be located despite valid certificate number and date of service
Rep confirms payment was issued over 30 days ago but practice has not received it
Denial reason references Green Shield systems — may be a routing error
Claim is flagged for audit — requires clinical documentation submission
COB dispute where both carriers are denying as secondary
ai_agent_guidance.representative_script_hints: RBC Insurance dental is administered through providerConnect (Green Shield infrastructure). Reps are trained on the portal and can usually locate claims quickly with certificate number and date of service. If they say 'not found', first verify you are using carrier ID 000124 and that the member ID was entered without hyphens.

metadata.notes: RBC Insurance migrated from Green Shield Canada carrier ID to their own ID (000124) in October 2016. Some older practices may still have the wrong carrier configured. providerConnect.ca is the portal.
